144717: Adachi Sakura is a high school student. She is found skipping class on the second floor of the gym by Shimamura Hougetsu one day. The two of them gradually became friends and began to spend a lot of time together. Adachi had an extremely introverted personality.
144718: Shimamura Hougetsu is a high school student. She met Adachi while skipping class on the second floor of the gym in her school when Adachi accidentally walks in on her one day.
167926: Akira Hino is a high school student and Shimamura Hougetsu's friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, where she is visiting a bookstore with Shimamura Hougetsu and Nagafuji. Hino has shoulder length hair, tied into low twintails.
167927: Chikama Yashiro is a friend of Hino Akira, who met while they were fishing. Like Hino, Chikama makes her own sound effects, the most notably being the "breathing" sound for her space suit. In her introduction, she explains that she has come to Earth to find her brethren.
167928: Taeko Nagafuji is a high school student and Shimamura Hougetsu's friend. She is introduced in Chapter 2, along with Hino Akira, in a bookstore with Shimamura. Nagafuji has straight, shoulder length hair and wears glasses. She has a very mature figure.
